method: Constructive schedule-consistent qualification and non-qualification witnesses for every team; no simulated odds and no frequencies reported. Equal-schedule H2H first, then PF, then division record, then PA. Published Week9 rule: three automatic division berths plus four shared berths. A deterministic final fallback was never material to Mud proof.
